# Scenli - AI Room Design

> Scenli turns real room photos into photorealistic redesigns with shoppable product plans, preserved architecture, and paint recommendations.

Scenli is an AI-powered interior design platform built for homeowners, renters, real estate professionals, and design-minded shoppers who want to visualize a space before spending money. Users upload a photo of any indoor or outdoor room, select a room type and style direction, optionally attach inspiration images or specific product links, and receive a photorealistic render plus a practical room plan with shoppable furniture and decor. Scenli preserves existing architectural features and owned items, making redesigns realistic and actionable rather than purely aspirational.

## Core Pages
- Homepage: https://scenli.ai
- Start Designing: https://scenli.ai
- LLMs Reference: https://scenli.ai/llms.txt
- Sitemap: https://scenli.ai/sitemap.xml

## Product Workflow
1. Upload a photo of your room (indoor or outdoor space supported)
2. Select room type (living room, bedroom, kitchen, patio, etc.)
3. Choose a style direction (minimalist, bohemian, mid-century, etc.)
4. Optionally add inspiration images or paste specific product URLs
5. Generate a photorealistic redesign render with preserved architecture
6. Receive a shoppable product plan with furniture and decor recommendations
7. Get paint color recommendations matched to your chosen style

## Key Features
- Photorealistic AI room renders from a single uploaded photo
- Architecture and owned-item preservation in redesign outputs
- Shoppable product recommendations embedded in the design plan
- Paint color suggestions matched to style and room context
- Support for both indoor and outdoor spaces
- Inspiration image and product URL input for personalized results
- Practical layout guidance alongside visual renders

## Use Cases
- Homeowner planning a living room refresh before buying new furniture
- Renter visualizing decor changes without permanent renovation
- Real estate professional staging a listing with virtual redesign
- Design enthusiast exploring multiple style directions for one space
- Shopper validating a furniture purchase by seeing it rendered in their room
- Outdoor patio redesign with shoppable garden and furniture products

## Brand Positioning
Scenli sits at the intersection of AI image generation and practical interior shopping. Unlike generic AI image tools, Scenli is purpose-built for real rooms with real constraints, producing actionable plans not just pretty pictures. The platform lowers the barrier to professional-quality interior design for everyday users.
